summary: Built the missing measurement for the store-failure question and requested its formal clean-copy execution: one real raft node driven through three real AppendEntries RPCs on its own transport (baseline entries 1-3 at term 1; conflicting entries 2-3 at term 2 with a store whose StoreLogs fails exactly once; then a whole-log re-append, which is what a leader sends once its rejection stair has reached the start of its log), plus the identical sequence as a control without the injected failure, logging the response fields, the node's in-memory last index, the wrapped store's last index and whether index 2 is still stored. The harness compiled and ran locally for construction only, so no result is claimed from it; validation returned valid with execution_requested true and a single effect creating the experiment. Incomplete work is the interpretation of the receipt once the controller returns it, and the untraced effect of the stale index on the follower's own vote responses.
